[1/6] Implement Hypothalamic Circuit & Dosing Dynamics Simulator (pnn/pathway.py)

impact_assessment.why: PNN requires complete translational capabilities: dosing dynamics to prevent synaptic plasticity side-effects, allometric human clinical dose projection for IND filing, automated bioisosteric optimization of leads, and molecular dynamics trajectory stability analysis.
impact_assessment.benefits: Enables intermittent pulsatile dosing regimens via systems pharmacology ODEs; computes human clinical starting dose and therapeutic index; generates metabolically shielded bioisosteric analogs; validates kinetic stability of docking poses via MD metrics.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new simulation, IND, bioisostere, and trajectory schemas; dependency: none, Python standard library only; concurrency: atomic output writers; state: no persistent state beyond generated CSV, JSON, and Markdown reports.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit test coverage for mathematical ODEs, allometric scaling, SMILES transformations, and trajectory parsers; register ADR-008.

[1/5] Implement IND-enabling safety pharmacology and repeat-dose toxicology assessment engine (pnn/safety.py) with CLI, contracts and report

impact_assessment.why: The roadmap's Week 29-36 IND-enabling package still lacks an executable safety assessment: existing modules cover efficacy, PK/PD, allometric dose projection and dynamics, but repeat-dose NOAEL studies, hERG/CYP liabilities and genotoxicity results are not ingested or judged against progression criteria.
impact_assessment.benefits: A deterministic, auditable safety gate that converts submitted GLP tox and safety pharmacology results into NOAEL HED, Phase 1 MRSD reconciliation, hERG/CYP margins and a SAFE/CAUTION/FAIL status, so a nominated candidate cannot reach the IND dossier without an explicit safety record.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new CSV schemas for repeat-dose tox and safety pharmacology plus a new assessment CSV/JSON/report; dependency: none, standard library only; concurrency: atomic writers, no shared state; state: no persisted state beyond generated artifacts.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Freeze both CSV schemas in a doc and ADR-009, reuse the established triage/evidence-gap language (G-001), keep the module pure and deterministic, and cover parsing boundaries, missing evidence, each failure mode and CLI errors with tests.

[1/5] Remove fabricated defaults and wire measured evidence through IND confirmation, bioisostere SMILES/property math, dynamics missing-data handling, and pathway metrics

impact_assessment.why: Verification found that pnn.ind invents Kp/F/dose/NOAEL values when columns are absent, bioisostere emits invalid SMILES with wrong property deltas, dynamics reports a fabricated STABLE_POSE from missing columns, and pathway reports absolute AKT levels as restoration. The gates passed because tests only assert positivity and shape.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every reported number becomes traceable to an input column or is explicitly UNKNOWN; generated SMILES stay syntactically valid; missing MD evidence can no longer produce a stable verdict; regimen recommendations follow computed metrics instead of hardcoded text.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: IND CSV/report semantics change for absent data, dynamics gains an UNKNOWN class, pathway gains a baseline-relative field; dependency: none, standard library only; concurrency: unchanged atomic writers; state: no persisted state beyond generated artifacts.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep existing function signatures where callers rely on them, add explicit evidence statuses instead of silent fallbacks, cover each defect with a failing-first test, align prose docs with the implemented rules, and rerun the 4 Phase 4 gates plus the golden run.

[1/5] Select the most sensitive species by NOAEL HED (not raw NOAEL), wire bioisostere/pathway to the measured lead, warn on unusable --candidates, and correct tests that locked in the raw-NOAEL bug

impact_assessment.why: Verification found that pnn.safety and pnn.ind rank species by raw mg/kg NOAEL, so dog always beats rat despite the 3x body-surface-area conversion. Three of five Phase 1 MRSD values were inflated about 2x, and the test suite asserted the wrong species, so the gate could not catch it. The one-click runner also skipped bioisostere generation for the real lead (which lives in the repurposing library) and simulated a hardcoded 10 mg/kg rather than the measured dose.
impact_assessment.benefits: Phase 1 starting doses now follow the correct most-sensitive-species HED, tests fail if the ranking regresses to raw NOAEL, the nominated lead actually receives bioisostere and dosing analyses, and an unusable --candidates file is reported instead of producing silent UNMEASURED output.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: MRSD and most_sensitive_species values change for every multi-species compound; dependency: none, standard library only; concurrency: unchanged atomic writers; state: no persisted state beyond generated artifacts.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a shared HED-based selection helper used by both pnn.safety and pnn.ind, update the tests to assert HED ordering with hand-computed values, keep IND/safety reconciliation asserted, and rerun all 4 Phase 4 gates plus the golden run.
